name: alda
source:
Two and a half years have passed since the reforms.
The anger of suffering citizens seems to be surfacing in many places.
Many paintings have been stolen.
Famous structures have been destroyed.

Changes have also begun to take place around Alda.
Diverse ideologies seem to be dividing people.
The changing world is casting her friends in a different light.

Alda now finds herself in the midst of transformation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5143110/alda/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
距离那场变革已经过去了两年半。
饱受苦难的民众的怒火似乎正在各地浮现。
众多画作接连失窃，
著名的建筑遭到损毁。

阿尔达的身边也开始悄然发生改变。
迥异的意识形态似乎正将人们撕裂分化，
剧变的世界也让她的朋友们展现出了不同于往日的一面。

如今，阿尔达正置身于时代变革的漩涡中央。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5143110/alda/]Steam[/url]]
